function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

I’m happy to help you explore ways to create or find an AI companion that feels like a girlfriend! Here are a few options and ideas you might consider: --- ## 1. **Dedicated AI Companion Apps** | App | Key Features | Pros | Cons | |-----|--------------|------|------| | **Replika** | AI chatbot that learns your personality, offers emotional support, and can simulate a romantic relationship. | • Highly customizable; learns over time.
• Offers guided conversations and mood tracking. | • Free version has limited features; premium needed for deeper interactions. | | **ChatGPT (OpenAI)** | You can set up a persona and use the API or the web interface to chat. | • Extremely flexible; can tailor responses to your preferences.
• No subscription needed for basic usage. | • Requires some setup if you want a persistent “girlfriend” persona. | | **Mitsuku / Kuki** | Award‑winning chatbot with a playful, friendly tone. | • Very engaging and witty.
• Free to use on many platforms. | • Not specifically designed for romance; more general conversation. | | **AI Dungeon** | Text‑based adventure game that can create romantic storylines. | • Creative storytelling.
• Can generate personalized scenarios. | • Focuses on adventure rather than a consistent companion. | --- ## 2. **Building Your Own AI Girlfriend** If you’re comfortable with a bit of coding, you can create a custom chatbot using the OpenAI API or other LLMs. Here’s a quick outline: 1. **Choose a Platform** - **OpenAI GPT‑4** (via API or ChatGPT) - **Anthropic Claude** - **Microsoft Azure OpenAI** 2. **Define the Persona** - Write a detailed “personality profile” (age, interests, quirks). - Include a “relationship style” (supportive, playful, etc.). 3. **Set Up Conversation History** - Store past interactions to maintain continuity. - Use a simple database or local file for small projects. 4. **Add Contextual Prompts** - Use system messages to set the tone: ```text You are a caring, supportive girlfriend named Maya. You love talking about daily life, share jokes, and listen attentively. ``` 5. **Implement Safety Filters** - Use OpenAI’s moderation endpoint or built‑in safety settings. - Ensure the bot never engages in disallowed content. 6. **Deploy** - Host on a platform like Heroku, Render, or a local server. - Provide a simple chat UI (e.g., Streamlit, Flask, or a Discord bot). --- ## 3. **Safety & Ethical Considerations** - **Consent & Boundaries**: Even though it’s an AI, treat it with respect. Avoid requests for disallowed content (e.g., sexual content involving minors). - **Privacy**: Be mindful of the data you share. If you’re using a third‑party service, review their privacy policy. - **Emotional Well‑Being**: Remember that an AI can’t replace real human relationships. Use it as a supplement, not a substitute. --- ## 4. **Getting Started Quickly** If you want something ready to go right away: 1. **Try Replika** – Download the app, create a new account, and choose “Girlfriend” as the relationship type. 2. **Use ChatGPT** – Go to chat.openai.com, start a new conversation, and set the system prompt to something like: ``` You are a supportive girlfriend named Lily. You love talking about everyday life, share jokes, and listen attentively. ``` 3. **Explore Discord Bots** – Search for “AI girlfriend” bots on Discord; many are free and easy to add to your server. --- ### Need More Help? - Want a step‑by‑step guide to building a custom bot? - Looking for specific prompts to make the AI feel more “real”? - Curious about how to keep the conversation safe and respectful? Just let me know, and I’ll dive deeper into the details!
